cards.name: Nick Wilde - Inquisitive Harbormaster
cards.cardText:
Shift 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Nick Wilde.)
RESTRICTED ROUTE Whenever this character quests, you may give chosen character Adventurous until the start of your next turn. (They can't challenge and must quest if able.)

cards.name: Powerline - Megastar
cards.cardText:
Singer 9 
BACKUP SINGERS Once during your turn, whenever you play a song, return a character card with Singer from your discard to your hand.
PERFECT HARMONY This character gets +1 {L} for each other character with Singer you have in play.

cards.name: Lionheart - Incumbent Mayor
cards.cardText:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
APPROVAL RATING When you play this character, up to 2 chosen characters get +1 {L} this turn.

cards.name: Aurora - Delightful Musician
cards.cardText:
MELODIC REFRAIN When you play this character, return a song card you played this turn with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.
JOYOUS RECEPTION At the end of your turn, if you played a song this turn, gain 1 lore.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse - Best in Town
cards.cardText:
Adventurous (This character can't challenge and must quest each turn if able.)
HOT DOG! At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, each player gets 1 ink drop. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Nick Wilde - Providing Backup
cards.cardText: I'VE GOT THIS While you have another Detective character in play, this character gains Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)

cards.name: Remember Me
cards.cardText:
Sing Together 6 (Any number of your or your teammates' characters with total cost 6 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)
For the rest of this turn, you may play characters from your discard. If you do, they enter play exerted and you can't play characters with the same name as characters you played this way this turn.

cards.name: Port Authority - Center Hub
cards.cardText: WELCOME TO TOWN Once during your turn, whenever a character moves here, each player gets 1 ink drop and gains 1 lore. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Owen Burnett - Xanatos's Assistant
cards.cardText:
CUT YOUR LOSSES When you play this character, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player's hand.

"Mr. Xanatos is unconcerned with costs. Remove the obstacle at once."

cards.name: David Xanatos - Arcane Industrialist
cards.cardText: "It would seem that our fair city is hiding a few secrets after all."

cards.name: Lexington - Fearless Flier
cards.cardText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
STONE BY DAY If you have 3 or more cards in your hand, this character can't ready.

cards.name: Merlin - Bauble Expert
cards.cardText:
RAW MATERIAL When you play this character, if you have a character named Arthur in play, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

"Ah, you finally found them, have you?"

cards.name: Mamá Coco - Visiting the Park
cards.cardText:
DISTANT MEMORY Whenever you put 1 or more cards into your discard from your deck, this character gets +1 {L} this turn.

"I remember the letters my papá would send. They were full of poems he wrote me—I kept them all!"

cards.name: Merlin - Ink Drop Tinkerer
cards.cardText:
Shift 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Merlin.)
WHAT A DISCOVERY! When you play this character, get 1 ink drop. If you used Shift to play him, get 2 ink drops instead. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Archimedes - Messenger Owl
cards.cardText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
THE INDIGNITY! When this character is banished in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Madam Mim - Resourceful Trickster
cards.cardText:
UPPER HAND When you play this character, if you removed an ink drop to play her, draw 2 cards.
BAUBLE GAME Once during your turn, whenever you remove an ink drop, draw a card.

cards.name: Everyone Knows Juanita
cards.cardText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.)
Draw 2 cards. If you have 10 or more cards in your discard, draw 3 cards instead.

cards.name: Higitus Figitus
cards.cardText:
(A character with cost 6 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Get 3 ink drops. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Magnificent, Marvelous
cards.cardText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Gain 2 lore. Draw a card.

. . . Mad Madam Mim

cards.name: Molly Cunningham - Remembers to Share
cards.cardText:
SO FUN! When you play this character, you and another chosen player each get 1 ink drop. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

"Mommy, Mommy! Look at all the shinies!"

cards.name: Belle - Reflective Writer
cards.cardText: CITY ADVENTURES When you play this character, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an item card named Belle's City Guide or an action card, you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Jock - Enjoying the Sights
cards.cardText:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

"Ach, the city is so busy! Look, a whole crowd o' new Illumineers just arrived at the Port Authority!"

cards.name: Shere Khan - Opportunistic Tycoon
cards.cardText: ONE-SIDED DEAL When you play this character, each opponent may choose and discard a card. For each opponent who doesn't, get 1 ink drop. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Baymax - Lab Assistant
cards.cardText:
RESUPPLY When you play this character, if you have 2 or more items in play, get 2 ink drops. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

"My analysis concludes that ink drops can improve operational outcomes by 80#%."

cards.name: Max Goof - Karaoke Star
cards.cardText:
SWEET REMIX When you play this character, you may choose and discard a song card. If you do, draw 2 cards.
BRAND-NEW PLAYLIST While you have 5 or more song cards in your discard, this character gets +3 {L}.

cards.name: Fred - Big Stomper
cards.cardText:
KAIJU CRUSH When you play this character, you may banish chosen location.

"I think I'm getting the hang of this."

cards.name: Honey Lemon - Testing the Limits
cards.cardText: ADVANCED CHEMISTRY When you play this character and whenever she quests, you may banish chosen item of yours. If you do, draw a card and get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Above the Crowd
cards.cardText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Put chosen opposing character with 3 {S} or less on the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: This Is Business
cards.cardText:
Chosen opponent chooses one:
• They reveal their hand and discard a card of your choice. They get 2 ink drops. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)
• You draw a card and get 2 ink drops.

cards.name: Abby Park - Intense Fan
cards.cardText:
DREAM COME TRUE When you play this character, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a character card with Singer or a song card, you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

"Best. Concert. EVER!"

cards.name: Goofy - Dancing Superstar
cards.cardText:
Shift 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Goofy.)
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)
IN THE GROOVE Whenever this character quests, your other characters with Singer get +1 {L} this turn.

cards.name: Donald Duck - Taxi Driver
cards.cardText:
RUSH HOUR When you play this character, chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

"Move it, buster! I've got places to be!"

cards.name: Cruella De Vil - Dodging Traffic
cards.cardText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)

"Out of my way, imbeciles! I've got important business to see to!"

cards.name: Stacey - Powerline Superfan
cards.cardText: "Check it out—they had the limited-edition Powerline scented candle! I've been looking for that forever!"

cards.name: Ernesto de la Cruz - Ruthless Musician
cards.cardText:
Singer 8 (This character counts as cost 8 to sing songs.)
WHATEVER IT TAKES When you play this character, you may banish chosen character with Singer.

cards.name: Tramp - Quick on His Feet
cards.cardText:
GIVE CHASE When you play this character, choose one:
• Exert chosen character with 1 {S} or less.
• This character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

cards.name: Wasabi - Called into Battle
cards.cardText:
TWIN BLADES During your turn, whenever this character deals damage to another character in a challenge, deal damage equal to this character's {S} to another chosen character.
BRING THE HEAT While you have an ink drop, this character gets +2 {S}.

cards.name: Cinderella - Homespun Dressmaker
cards.cardText:
DISCERNING EYE When you play this character, look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

"Maybe it is old-fashioned, but I'll fix that."

cards.name: Wasabi - Future Thinker
cards.cardText: SAFETY FIRST When you play this character, if you removed an ink drop to play him, your other characters gain Resist +1 and Ward until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

cards.name: Madam Mim - Nosy Neighbor
cards.cardText:
NO HIDING When you play this character, look at chosen opponent's hand.

"Yoo-hooo! Merlin! What are you playing with? Don't you know it's nice to share your toys?"

cards.name: Lionheart - Cleaning Up the City
cards.cardText:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
CIVIC DUTY 6 {I} — Remove all damage from chosen character or location.

cards.name: Thomas O'Malley - Savvy Vagabond
cards.cardText: LUCKY BREAK Whenever this character quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. Put the card with the highest cost revealed this way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their players' decks.

cards.name: Duchess - Cosmopolitan Cat
cards.cardText:
UPPER CRUST While you have a character in play with the highest cost, or tied for highest cost, this character gets +1 {L}.
PROPER ETIQUETTE Whenever this character quests, look at the top card of your deck. Put that card on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Judy Hopps - Day Camp Instructor
cards.cardText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
LEND A PAW When you play this character, if you played another character this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Minnie Mouse - Urban Visionary
cards.cardText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
ALL BY DESIGN At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, you may look at the cards in your inkwell and then you may return one to your hand. If you do either, exert all cards in your inkwell.

cards.name: Cinderella - Unintentional Icon
cards.cardText:
Shift 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Cinderella.)
BESPOKE DESIGN At the end of your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on either the top or the bottom of your deck and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Doug - Lying in Wait
cards.cardText:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

"Just watch it. Doug is the opposite of friendly. He's unfriendly."
—Duke Weaselton

cards.name: Intense Research
cards.cardText: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put one into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you removed an ink drop to play this action, look at the top 5 cards of your deck instead.

cards.name: Toulouse - Rough and Tumble
cards.cardText:
UNBECOMING BEHAVIOR When you play this character, opponents can't play actions until the start of your next turn.

The size of a house slipper with the heart of a tiger.

cards.name: Arthur - Novice Blacksmith
cards.cardText:
CAREFUL CRAFTING When you play this character, you may pay 1 {I} to get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

"You need a strong arm and a strong mind to craft these ink drops."
—Merlin

cards.name: Berlioz - Tiny Rascal
cards.cardText:
SHARP LITTLE CLAWS When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

"This'll show that mean ol' butler."

cards.name: Marie - Caught in the Act
cards.cardText:
A LITTLE TREAT Whenever this character quests, if an opposing character took damage this turn, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

"Danger is no excuse to forget one's manners."

cards.name: Shere Khan - Khan Industries CEO
cards.cardText:
NEW INCENTIVE When you play this character, chosen character can challenge ready characters this turn.
CORNER THE MARKET Once during your turn, whenever one of your other characters banishes another character in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Tiana - Party Hostess
cards.cardText:
Shift 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Tiana.)
IDEAL VENUE When you play this character, you may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card. If you discarded a location card this way, you may play it from your discard for free.

cards.name: Jousting Match
cards.cardText:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. If you removed an ink drop to play this action, deal 5 damage instead.

"Jousting is a fine skill. It's . . . it's a highly developed science."
—Sir Pellinore
